learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the art of being an amazing audience member, understanding performance critiques, and using helpful feedback to grow as an artist!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Watching a play is not like watching TV. An active viewer pays attention to the lights, the actor's expressions, and the background sounds to fully appreciate the hard work of the theatre team.
When giving advice to a fellow actor, use the sandwich method! Start with something you loved, add a polite suggestion on what they can improve, and end with an encouraging cheer.
Receiving feedback can feel scary, but it is actually a superpower. Listening to a director's advice helps you fix your mistakes and transforms you into a much stronger and smarter performer.

fun_activity.title: 📝 The Star Reviewer
fun_activity.instructions: Watch a 5-minute animated short film or a small skit online. Write a two-sentence review sharing what the actors did best and one thing that could have been even cooler!

quick_recap: ⭐ Being a good audience member means being respectful, attentive, and generous with your applause.
⭐ Constructive feedback should always be kind, helpful, and aimed at making the performance better.
⭐ Smart actors listen to advice and use it as stepping stones to improve their theatrical skills.
